tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · FY2026 Internal Control Walkthroughs
tasks.description: Walk through HANGS General Contracting LP's key controls for FY2026 for Cinderbrook Bank and the board, from 11 Excel, PDF and Word files: the approval matrix and process narratives, the user access report, the vendor changes and payments, the pay applications and receipts, the payroll approvals and rate changes, the manual journal entries, the twelve bank reconciliations, the trial balance and the walkthrough notes. SOX-style for a private company: purchasing to pay, billing to cash, payroll, the close and user access; design and implementation, then operating instances by seeded sample or whole population. Rate each control and propose a severity and a recommendation for each deficiency in formula-linked workpapers and draft findings. The CPA decides every level and reports; the machine gives no opinion on internal control.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with tickmarks, a control matrix and evidence tabs, and draft control findings PDF for the CPA with evidence trails and the original files attached
tasks.outputsPath: Outputs/HANGS General Contracting FY2026 Control Walkthroughs
tasks.gates: Draft workpapers and findings, not reviewed, concluded or signed. Not an examination of internal control and no opinion. Open items stay open. The CPA decides and reports.

run.title: HANGS General Contracting · FY2026 Internal Control Walkthroughs

steps.text: Ready for the Lender and the Board

lines.text: 11 key controls: purchasing to pay P2P-1, P2P-2, P2P-3; billing to cash B2C-1, B2C-2; payroll PAY-1, PAY-2, PAY-3; the close CLS-1, CLS-2; and user access ITG-1. The approval matrix adopted January 15, 2024 sets the terms: the preparer of a payment cannot approve it, payments of $100,000 or more need a second approval, journal entries over $25,000 need a second review, and bank reconciliations are due within 15 days. Severity is weighed against the year-end audit’s $350,000.00 materiality; the CPA decides every level.

events.locator: Word document; the four processes, system access and their eleven key controls

events.result: 11 key controls: purchasing to pay P2P-1, P2P-2, P2P-3; billing to cash B2C-1, B2C-2; payroll PAY-1, PAY-2, PAY-3; the close CLS-1, CLS-2; and user access ITG-1. The approval matrix adopted January 15, 2024 sets the terms: the preparer of a payment cannot approve it, payments of $100,000 or more need a second approval, journal entries over $25,000 need a second review, and bank reconciliations are due within 15 days. Severity is weighed against the year-end audit’s $350,000.00 materiality; the CPA decides every level.
